context.transcript:
Are you all set to pay, Ms. Rodriguez?
Your new haircut looks really nice, by the way.
Thanks.
As usual, Marla did a really good job.
Hmm.
I was wondering if I could apply this coupon to today's haircut.
It says it expired yesterday, but I just wanted to see if you'd accept it.
Sure, we can take that.
By the way, we're also offering 50% off on all hair products until the end of next month.
Oh, that's good to know, since I've run out of shampoo.
I'll take a look at what you have and see if there's something I'd like to buy.
context.transcript_translation:
罗德里格斯女士，您准备好付款了吗？
顺便说一句，您的新发型看起来真的很漂亮。
谢谢。
一如既往地，Marla 干得非常好。
嗯。
我想知道是否可以将这张优惠券用于今天的理发服务。
上面写着它昨天就过期了，但我只是想看看您是否接受。
当然可以，我们可以接受。
顺便说一句，直到下个月底，我们还在所有护发产品上提供五折优惠。
哦，知道这个很好，因为我的洗发水用完了。
我看看您有什么，然后决定是否购买一些。
